notes: This draft manifest is not yet promoted into the primary phase06_ui_sample_manifest.json.
Its purpose is to continue the regular Phase06 source supply after P12 closed and the formal checkpoint reached 54/54 live passed.

The selected files stay inside the remaining official HarmonyOS-Examples reserve; where a page still needs helpers, the helpers are frozen explicitly instead of relying on hidden same-package pressure.

ordered_samples.usage_goal: Add the remaining official CommonUI route shell so the regular lane keeps one explicit button-driven Router menu anchor after the P12 promotion.

source.purpose: P13 draft candidate harvested from the remaining official HarmonyOS-Examples reserve after the regular Phase06 checkpoint reached 54/54 live passed.

blocking_constraints: Keep the extend Button.jump helper and the eight Router.push targets source-backed inside the page shell; do not invent detached route coordinators or menu helper layers.

ordered_samples.usage_goal: Add a timer-driven canvas clock sample that keeps lifecycle-owned redraw scheduling in the page shell while freezing the drawing helper explicitly as a renderer support slice.

source.purpose: P13 draft candidate selected from the remaining official HarmonyOS-Examples reserve to extend timer plus canvas-render coverage with one explicit helper freeze.

blocking_constraints: Keep the page-owned Timer lifecycle, CanvasRenderingContext2D ownership, and display-size hydration in the host page, and keep dial/hand drawing logic source-backed in utils/clock.cj rather than collapsing it into a fake single-file shell.

ordered_samples.usage_goal: Add an interactive geometry playground that keeps touch-mode switching and canvas host ownership in the page shell while freezing the dynamic geometry and math helpers explicitly as support slices.

source.purpose: P13 draft candidate selected from the remaining official HarmonyOS-Examples reserve because its helper surface becomes acceptable once all same-package geometry dependencies are frozen transparently.

blocking_constraints: Keep current mode selection, touch dispatch, point/circle host state, and Shape event wiring in the page shell; keep dynamic geometry entities plus geometric intersection math source-backed in DGeometry.cj and Geometry.cj rather than pretending the page is self-contained.

tag_rules.resolution_rule: Each file-level sample must resolve to exactly one structure_tag and one ownership_tag. interaction/exception/sample_scope tags are additive only.
